title: 第17章 局势逆转活捉凰曦儿第18章 所有人跟我追杀十万里
slug: 重生魔帝开局骗女帝下界双修
content_zh:
在数百万上千万修士的注视下。
林云一人独战群雄。
好几次险象环生，血染长空！
尤其是那几位正道魁首，出手刁钻无比。
每一次都是几乎以偷袭的方式。
对林云也是造成了实质性的伤害。
“哈哈哈哈，你们这一群废物，还以为你们多厉害呢。”
“要是单打独斗，劳资一只手就捏死你们！”
林云还在嚣张的叫嚣着。
仿佛身上的血迹都不是他的一般。
用手擦了擦嘴角的血迹。
林云心中却是在暗中计算着。
时机差不多快到了。
正所谓舍不得孩子套不着狼。
自己要是不受伤，不表现的真实一点。
他们怕是都不会大意。
随时都会留有余力作为逃遁的后路。
对于这群正道伪君子，林云可太了解了。
即使是现在，他们也还在互相提防着呢，根本就没有全力出手。
不然自己只是展露现在这种层次的修为。

根本就招架不住。
在林云的讥讽嘲笑下。
一群仙宗领袖也是感觉面上无光。
毕竟围攻人家一个都打到现在这种焦灼的地步。
确实是显得有些无能了。
所以攻势也是愈发冷厉，慢慢开始不再留手。
林云也是愈发的险象环生。
好几次被神通正面击中。
就在九大领袖以为胜券在握，攻势压得更猛时。
林云眼底寒光一闪，时机到了。
对面那几人已经开始有人按捺不住开始全力出手了。
这时候，也是最不设防的时候。
正所谓旧力已去，但是新力未生的尴尬时期。
根本来不及反应。
林云的气息猛地爆开！
content_en:
Under the gaze of millions of monks.
Lin Yun fought against the heroes alone.
There were many dangers and the sky was stained with blood!
Especially those leaders of the righteous path are extremely cunning.
Every time it was almost a sneak attack.
It also caused substantial damage to Lin Yun.
"Hahahaha, you bunch of trash, you really think you are so powerful."
"If you fight alone, labor and management will crush you to death with one hand!"
Lin Yun was still shouting arrogantly.
It was as if the blood on his body was not his.
He wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth with his hand.
Lin Yun was secretly calculating in his heart.
The time is almost here.
As the saying goes, if you are reluctant to let go of your children, you will not be able to trap the wolf.
If you don't get hurt, don't act more truthfully.
I'm afraid they won't be careless.
There will always be room for escape at any time.
Lin Yun knew this group of righteous hypocrites very well.
Even now, they are still wary of each other and have not taken full action at all.
Otherwise, I would just show my current level of cultivation.
I simply couldn’t resist it.
Under Lin Yun's sarcasm.
A group of leaders of the Immortal Sect also felt that they were disgraced.
After all, everyone who was besieged has been beaten to this point of anxiety.
It does seem a bit incompetent.
Therefore, the offensive became more and more severe, and slowly began to stop holding back.
Lin Yun is also increasingly in danger.
He was hit head-on by supernatural powers several times.
Just when the nine leaders thought they had a chance to win, they pressed harder.
Lin Yun's eyes flashed coldly, the time had come.
Some of the people on the opposite side could no longer hold back and began to take action with all their strength.
This is also the time when you are least defensive.
As the saying goes, the old strength is gone, but the new strength is not yet born.
There was no time to react.
Lin Yun's aura suddenly exploded!
